title: Prove the sharp one-inverse positive Q8 tariff
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact positive-label Q8 tariff with one negative generator target, any number of positive generator targets and arbitrary restored dirty workspace.

```text
paid labels: i,j; target list: {1,i,zi,j,zj}, exactly one zi/zj
minimum = alpha*s_i + beta*s_j + 2*min(alpha,beta)
```

The new equality argument forces mutually orthogonal projectors at the inverse-label bill, excluding every signed coefficient. Idempotent trace parity then forces two extra calls. The written proof covers arbitrary finite roles and nonnegative real prices. This closes one boundary of PR3450's positive-only handoff; it adds no new two-role values beyond Aaron Wang's PR2318 census. Multiple-negative sharp tariffs, physical compiler/caller, supplier and kappa remain unclaimed.

Only `research/q8-positive-one-inverse/` changes. PR2587/ywz65's coefficient-support method, PR3450's combined character, PR2318 and the retained register-model lineage keep their credit. The unmodified PR3450 proof is retained inside the package, so no unmerged foreign Git object is needed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the sign-blind quotient gives the generator baseline and identifies i with zi; it cannot validate a signed endpoint. **After:** full coefficient support and equality force the sharp two-call excess. The actual verifier rejects stripped sign calls, an underpriced producer and a dirty-spectator fault.
- Exact receipt covers 180,709 short words, 2,828 attaining price cases, 83,328 faithful dirty-input columns and 1,648 factor omissions. These finite checks corroborate PROOF.md rather than quantifying over all words.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized behavioral controls, Ruff E/F/B/UP/SIM, exact committed bytes/source history and the actual committed Git-free replay pass. Export payload bytes, modes and inodes remain unchanged.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.12, setting TMPDIR to a private external directory:

```sh
python3 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-positive-one-inverse
python3 -I -O -Werror -B research/q8-positive-one-inverse/verify.py
```

Canonical baseline/submission main is 6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19009913). Full selected cold replay, Lean, physical invoice and all-size multiplication proof are unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. One isolated opt-in research package can be reverted.

**Blast Radius:** package. Selected sources, shared tooling and the selected frontier are unchanged.
